page.layout: One page of running text, with a tree diagram in the middle. Marginal notes in the left margin: "Vide A-thenæü lib.14." beside the diagram and "Genus." beside the paragraph "Deinde est apud Pindarum". Running head at top right, page number top left, catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: simum genus musices lyra posse canere in conuiuiis, quod vel vnus Themistocles suo exemplo confirmauit:nam vt refert Cicero in Tusc. quum in epulis recusaret lyra, habitus est indoctior. Et Plato 3. Polit. lyram cum cithara & fistula ad rem bellicam tanquam vtilem coniungit :& idem Plato ζ. τῶν νόμων pueris discendam cum aliis artibus proponit.
Fuere in eo genere excellentes multi, nouem tamen Græcis carminibus referuntur.

p.i: Ἀυ[?]τὸ[?] πιν[?]πτὴ εἰσιν ἐννέα, Ἀλκαῖος, Σαπφώ, Στησίχορος, Ἴβυκος, βακχυλίδης, Σιμωνίδης Ἀλκμάν, Ἀνάκρεων, ἡ Πίνδαρος.

main_text.p: Sunt autem Lyrici carminis tres species, vt ex hac diuisi-one patebit.
main_text.l: 2. ὑπορχηματικὴ, in qua chorus canens saltat.
3. γυμνοπαιδικὴ in qua pueri exercebātur, antequam ad πυρ-ρίχην peruenirent.
main_text.p: Genus. Deinde est apud Pindarum ἁπλὴ διήγησις, nuda laudum commemoratio, δὲ ἀπαγγελίας, vti in dithyrambicis solet. Est igitur genus τὸ περιφορικὸν ἀμεταβλητὸν, διθυραμβικὸν, ἁπλῇ διηγήσει constans: ac epidictici generis ferme omnia.
main_text.head: Materia.
main_text.p: Deorum, Heroum, victorum, equorum laudes, & ip-sarum victoriarum comendationes, [illegible, ~12 letters] cuius locos suo loco videbimus.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("simum") running on from the previous page; left as printed. The three Greek verse lines are only partly legible: the names Ἀλκαῖος, Σαπφώ, Στησίχορος, Ἴβυκος, βακχυλίδης, Σιμωνίδης, Ἀνάκρεων and Πίνδαρος are read from the scan, but the first line and several letters are doubtful and marked [?]. The Greek phrase after "comendationes," is not legible letter by letter. The Greek reference "ζ. τῶν νόμων" is doubtful. Printed spacing "confirmauit:nam" and "indoctior.Et" and "Plato ζ." are kept as printed. The faint text at the right of the scan is show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed. The marginal note "Vide A-thenæü lib.14." is placed in its own paragraph beside the diagram, as the diagram is an outline and cannot carry it inline.
